messages:
Jay: Heads-up — EU POC (FinTech customer) keeps getting degraded outputs after we pin to gpt-4o-lite@2025-11-01. They say quality drops and sometimes the model is unavailable. Can engineering help triage?
Ana: Paging @Sam @Emma — this is on Ana's pipeline for onboarding, customer demo Fri.
Sam: Looking. Do we have request_id/logs?
Jay: Got a snippet from their logs, pasted below. They also saw some 429s earlier.
Jay: ```
ERROR model_not_available_in_region: model=gpt-4o-lite region=eu-west-1 request_id=abc123
WARN fallback_to_compat: using gpt-4o-medium, latency=312ms
HTTP 429: rate_limit_exceeded, bucket=poc-eu-1
```
Emma: @Sam this looks like two separate things: (1) model not available in eu-west-1 for that exact pinned version, (2) burst rate limits causing 429s and fallback to lower-cap models which explains quality drop.
Sam: Confirmed. The pinned build gpt-4o-lite@2025-11-01 is only in us-west-2 and asia-southeast currently. Our region routing policy tries to fall back to nearest compatible variant which can be lower quality.
Jay: Customer specifically requested regional pin for data locality (legal). They explicitly asked for the exact version to be pinned.
Kevin: For sales: if they need guaranteed regional availability we should discuss Dedicated or private deployment. Quick numbers: reserved pool for eu-west starting at $11,500/mo for 2x 80T GPUs (baseline). I can draft a short quote.
Ana: They asked about timelines: can we replicate the pinned model in eu-west quickly or push a compatible variant?
Emma: We can stage a region pin but needs model onboarding + replication — about 3 business days if infra capacity is available. If capacity is constrained we need a capacity request and deploy window.
Sam: Short-term mitigation: change routing to block fallback to lower-cap variants and instead return explicit error so they can see the pinned model is missing (prevents silent quality regression). Example config snippet to set route policy: 
```json
{
  "routing": {
    "region_preference": ["eu-west-1"],
    "allow_variant_fallback": false,
    "error_on_missing_model": true
  }
}
```
Jay: Good call. Customer would prefer explicit error over silent quality loss. Can we apply that to their account?
Emma: Yes — can apply per-tenant routing policy. I'll prepare a safety rollback. Need approval from infra if it affects autoscaling.
Sam: Also observed their request patterns — bursts of many short chats which triggered our token-based rate limiter. For POC, we can temporarily raise their rate limits for 48h while we stabilize.
Ana: Please document the temporary quota bump and end time. Customer will run the demo Friday morning CET.
Kevin: I'll include dedicated pricing as an option and a note about timeline for regional replication.
Jay: Security question from customer: "Can private VPC + KMS be enabled if we go dedicated?"
Emma: Yes. Dedicated supports VPC peering and KMS/HSM integration. For Private (on-prem/VPC) we can do full control plane separation — that's a separate ent contract.
Sam: Action items: (1) Emma to flip allow_variant_fallback=false for tenant (temp), (2) Infra to queue regional model replication slot, (3) Sam to request quota bump for 48h, (4) Kevin to send draft dedicated quote + timeline.
Emma: I'll schedule the infra capacity check now and post ETA.
deploy-bot: Deployment window request submitted: ticket #INF-5721, priority=P1, awaiting capacity confirmation.
Sam: I'll monitor logs and set an alert for any unexpected 5xx after the routing change.
Ana: Thanks team — please post confirmation here once routing change and quota bump are live. I'll keep the customer updated with conservative timeline (3 business days for full replic). :thumbsup:
Jay: ETA update: routing change planned in 30m, quota bump in 10m, infra confirmation pending. I'll post runbook steps after change.
Emma: Routing change applied to tenant-roster-42. Rollback ready if errors.
Sam: Quota bumped to 3x normal for 48h (note in ticket). Watching.
Ana: Customer notified. Prep notes for demo: explain explicit model error + options (replicate vs dedicated).
Jay: Closing loop — will follow up after Fri demo. Thanks all. :clap:
